items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: We didn't have no room for two singers. We had Etta Jones.

ctx.x: So now what he does, he's got some heck of an ideas, Earl has, and he would get us singing together. He'd have Eddie, me and Benny Green over here, have Eddie in the middle, and then he'd have Helen Merrill over here, in the middle, and Aaron Sachs, and Aaron, Aaron would be there, and

Tommy Potter, and then we'd be singing, (Singing), "Beside a shady nook --," it was something nice. It sounded nice. But Helen isn't even on the payroll. She's just going along with Aaron, you know. "Come on," they'd say to her. We didn't have no room for two singers. We had Etta Jones. But he put her in there, because she'd do that one number, you know.
